reason: The new experimental oracle expected absolute 5060ms native duration. Existing NativeReader intentionally normalizes leading empty edits to first-picture time (60ms); this is explicit in playback/video/native.rs playback_edits and owned_video_timeline::map_edits. The newly drafted test does not establish a regression in that API. Kept as evidence of rejected assumption, not weakened into a passing media regression and not counted.
